notes: Files were downloaded from NCBI GEO/FTP over HTTPS with curl --ssl-no-revoke (Windows schannel CRL workaround).
Every ranged download was byte-checked against Content-Length before assembly; all final sizes match the server header.
The V1 RAW.tar is a GEO supplementary archive of per-sample count text files, not raw FASTQ.
GPL198.annot.gz has no TAIR AGI column; Entrez IDs were bridged to AGI through NCBI Arabidopsis gene_info before any V2 expression value was used.
